method: CUA native Safari and Chrome app controls; observed UI after each structural undo and redo. Downloaded file independently inspected with read-only JSON assertions. No page injection.

safari.initial: Seed heading rank 2 and prior Writeabc a first draft typing checkpoint. An undone control-character test existed on the redo branch; the new heading change intentionally superseded that test-only redo branch.
steps: Click heading text, Cmd+Left then Cmd+Shift+Right. AX selected text confirms Make room for your ideas.
Apply Heading 3, Bullet list, Numbered list, then Link https://example.com/breditor-persistence with new-window unchecked. Observe each intermediate structure.
Close Link popover; saved status remains All changes saved. Reload. Rank 3, numbered marker 1, Link and selected heading text are restored.
Click Undo four times with an observation after each: remove Link; restore bullet marker; remove wrapper; restore rank 2. Selected heading text and all unrelated content remain intact.
Reload with this redo branch. Selected heading text, rank 2 and available Redo are restored.
Click Redo four times with an observation after each: rank 3; bullet wrapper; numbered wrapper; Link. Link popover confirms exact URL and unchecked new-window option.
Download session backup. Accept local 127.0.0.1 download prompt; Safari Downloads shows breditor-session-backup-2.json, 10 KB.

Open the exact Safari-exported backup with the native file picker. Separate Recovered Breditor session appears with numbered heading, Link and Autosave is off. Main editor remains its earlier unwrapped heading and Writeabc a first draft.
Click recovered Undo four times, observing Link removal, numbered-to-bullet conversion, unwrap, and Heading 2 becoming the active disabled toolbar control. Main editor is unchanged.
Click recovered Redo four times, observing Heading 3, bullet wrapper, numbered wrapper and Link restoration. Selected heading text is retained during history traversal.
Open recovered Link popover: exact https://example.com/breditor-persistence URL and unchecked new-window option. Main editor remains unchanged; recovered autosave stays off.
uiInterruptions: First Go To path entry remained slash; setValue did not alter it. Rebinding and explicit typing produced a double-leading-slash absolute path, which the native picker resolved to the exact file. The filename and JSON preview were observed before Open.
After Open, native AX temporarily exposed a Find bar containing vin. Escape closed it; a fresh observation confirmed successful recovery. No editor error or cause for the Find bar is inferred.

backup.verification: Read-only assertions verified V6, cursor/entry count, all four new operation kinds, final heading rank 3, ordered layout start 1/items 1, exact Link URL and both serialized selection endpoints/affinities.
backup.retention: Downloaded test-only backup retained. No user-authored document data was used.

limits: One observed forward-selection workflow, not exhaustive structural selection, all ranks, backward-selection or crash-recovery coverage.
Safari native main-demo persistence and Safari-to-Chrome transfer are covered here. Chrome-native structural authoring/reload and Safari self-import are not inferred.
AX selected text proves the visible range, not DOM affinity independently. Exact logical endpoints/affinities are supported separately by the downloaded checkpoint assertions.
Native controls are not physical-human certification. IME, screen-reader qualification, intermittent WebKit fault, performance, size/delivery and full release gates remain open.
